objectifs: Give advice: If I were you

etapes.fr: Conditionnel de type 2 (situation imaginaire) : If + passé, … would + verbe.
etapes.en: If + past simple, would + verb: for imaginary situations.

exemples.en: If I had a lot of money, I would build a school.
exemples.fr: Si j'avais beaucoup d'argent, je construirais une école.

exemples.en: If she lived closer, we'd see her more.
exemples.fr: Si elle habitait plus près, on la verrait plus.

etapes.fr: Avec « be », on dit « were » pour toutes les personnes dans ce cas. Et « If I were you… » sert à donner un conseil.
etapes.en: « If I were you, I would… » is a polite way to give advice.

exemples.en: If I were you, I'd accept the job.
exemples.fr: À ta place, j'accepterais le poste.

exemples.en: If he were taller, he'd play basketball.
exemples.fr: S'il était plus grand, il jouerait au basket.

lignes.en: What would you do if you won the lottery?
lignes.fr: Que ferais-tu si tu gagnais à la loterie ?

lignes.en: I would buy a house for my mother and start a business.
lignes.fr: J'achèterais une maison pour ma mère et je lancerais une entreprise.

lignes.en: No way! If I stopped, I'd be bored.
lignes.fr: Pas question ! Si j'arrêtais, je m'ennuierais.

etapes.question: « If I ___ more time, I would learn Chinese. »
« If I were you, I ___ him. »
Type 1 or type 2? « If it rains tomorrow… » (c'est possible)

etapes.en: If I were rich I would travel around the world
etapes.fr: Si j'étais riche je ferais le tour du monde
À ta place, je ne dirais rien.
reponses: If I were you, I wouldn't say anything.
If I were you, I would not say anything.
If I were you, I'd say nothing.

etapes.en: What would you do in my place?
If I could live anywhere, I would live by the sea.
etapes.fr: Si je pouvais vivre n'importe où, je vivrais au bord de la mer.

resume: If + past, would + verb = imaginary. « were » for all persons. If I were you, I'd… = advice.
devoir: Answer: What would you do if you were the president for one day? (6 sentences)
